hook.convey: one whole shared into EQUAL parts → each part gets a name from how many equal parts the whole has: 4 equal parts → 1/4; a roti shared at home, a paper strip folded for a drawing

use.hi: Ghar mein roti barabar baanti jaati hai; har hisse ka naam hota hai.
use.en: At home a roti is shared equally; each part has a name.

use.hi: Drawing ka kaagaz modo ya roti baanto: har barabar hisse ka naam hota hai.
use.en: Fold drawing paper or share a roti: each equal part has a name.

explain.convey: roti in 4 equal parts → one part = 1/4 = one of 4 equal parts = a fractional unit; the bottom number = how many equal parts the whole has; the card: a same-size roti in 8 equal parts on its own board → the child names its unit

viewCaption.hi: Yahan wahi roti ek seedhi patti ki tarah khuli hai: 4 barabar hisse, aur ek hisse mein rang.
viewCaption.en: Here the same roti is opened out like a straight strip: 4 equal parts, and one part coloured.

point.hi: Yeh roti 4 barabar hisson mein bati hai, aur rang wala hissa 1/4 hai. Barabar hisson mein se aisa ek hissa fractional unit kehlata hai.
point.en: This roti is in 4 equal parts, and the coloured part is 1/4. One such part out of equal parts is called a fractional unit.

pointAlt.hi: Socho chaar dost yeh roti barabar baant-te hain. Har dost ke haath chaar barabar hisson mein se ek aata hai, jaise yeh rang wala hissa: roti ka 1/4. Aise ek hisse ko fractional unit kehte hain.
pointAlt.en: Picture four friends sharing this roti equally. Each friend gets one of the four equal parts, like this coloured part: 1/4 of the roti. One part like that is called a fractional unit.

prompt.hi: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
prompt.en: Now look at the roti beside it, just as big, but in 8 equal parts. Which fractional unit is one of its parts?

hindi.hi: Doosri roti ke 8 hisse hain, sab ek jitne bade. Unmein se ek hisse ko kya naam doge?
hindi.en: The other roti has 8 parts, all the same size. What name will you give one of them?

point.en: Look at two strips, each in 3 parts. A's three parts are equal, so each part is 1/3. B's parts are big and small, so we can't call them 1/3 by counting.

point.en: Now take two ribbons: P is 20 cm, Q is 12 cm. 1/2 of P is 10 cm, and 1/2 of Q is 6 cm. The name is the same, 1/2, but the whole is different, so the length is different.

reask.en: Of the 6, 2, 6 and 2 cm parts of a 16 cm chocolate, how many are 1/4?

did.hi: chocolate ke hisson mein 1/4 wale hisse dhoondhe
did.en: looked for the parts that are 1/4 among a chocolate's parts

viewCaption.hi: Board par chocolate ek lambi patti hai, wahin kati jahan woh tooti: 6, 2, 6 aur 2 cm ke hisse.
viewCaption.en: On the board the chocolate is one long strip, cut where it broke: parts of 6, 2, 6 and 2 cm.

pictureCaption.hi: Yahan wahi chocolate scale par rakhi hai; nishaan wahan hain jahan woh tooti thi.
pictureCaption.en: Here the same chocolate lies on a scale; the marks are where it broke.

why.hi: 16 cm ka 1/4 16 ÷ 4 = 4 cm hota, aur koi bhi hissa 4 cm ka nahi, toh 0 hisse
why.en: 1/4 of 16 cm is 16 ÷ 4 = 4 cm, and no part is 4 cm, so 0 parts

whyShort.hi: 1/4 wala hissa 4 cm ka hota; aisa koi nahi
whyShort.en: a 1/4 part would be 4 cm; none is

whyAlt.hi: Hisse 4 hain, par chhote-bade hain; 1/4 kehne ke liye hisse ki lambai chaar barabar hisson mein se ek jitni honi chahiye.
whyAlt.en: There are 4 parts, but big and small; to call a part 1/4, its length must match one of four equal parts.

simpler.hi: Socho, chocolate chaar barabar hisson mein toot-ti toh har hissa kitna lamba hota. Phir dekho kaunse hisse utne lambe hain.
simpler.en: Think how long each part would be if the chocolate broke into four equal parts. Then see which parts are that long.

prompt.hi: Ek ribbon 60 cm ki hai aur doosri 30 cm ki. Rahul ne pehli ka 1/3 liya, aur Sana ne doosri ka 1/2. Dono ke hisson mein kitne cm ka fark hai?
prompt.en: One ribbon is 60 cm and the other 30 cm. Rahul took 1/3 of the first, and Sana took 1/2 of the second. How many cm apart are their two parts?

reask.hi: 60 cm ki ribbon ka 1/3 aur 30 cm ki ribbon ka 1/2: in dono mein kitne cm ka fark hai?
reask.en: 1/3 of a 60 cm ribbon and 1/2 of a 30 cm ribbon: how many cm apart are these two?

did.hi: alag lambai ki ribbon ke 1/3 aur 1/2 ka fark nikala
did.en: found the difference between 1/3 and 1/2 of ribbons of different lengths

why.hi: 60 aur 30 toh poori ribbons ki lambai hai; Rahul aur Sana ke paas sirf unke hisse hain.
why.en: 60 and 30 are the whole ribbons' lengths; Rahul and Sana only have parts of them.

why.hi: 20 cm akele Rahul ke hisse ki lambai hai; sawaal do hisson ke beech ka antar poochh raha hai.
why.en: 20 cm is the length of Rahul's part alone; the question asks how far apart the two parts are.

viewCaption.hi: Board par dono poori ribbon apni lambai ki pattiyan hain: upar Rahul wali 60 cm, neeche Sana wali 30 cm.
viewCaption.en: On the board the two whole ribbons are strips as long as they are: Rahul's 60 cm above, Sana's 30 cm below.

pictureCaption.hi: Yahan dono ribbon ek hi scale par hain: Sana wali 30 cm par khatam hoti hai, Rahul wali 60 cm par.
pictureCaption.en: Here both ribbons are on one scale: Sana's ends at 30 cm, Rahul's at 60 cm.

why.hi: Rahul ka hissa 60 ÷ 3 = 20 cm, Sana ka 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm; 20 − 15 = 5
why.en: Rahul's part is 60 ÷ 3 = 20 cm, Sana's 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm; 20 − 15 = 5

whyShort.hi: Rahul ka hissa 20 cm, Sana ka 15 cm
whyShort.en: Rahul's part is 20 cm, Sana's 15 cm

whyAlt.hi: Sana ka 1/2 sirf 30 cm wali ribbon ka hai, Rahul ka 1/3 60 cm wali ka; dono hisse cm mein nikaal kar milao.
whyAlt.en: Sana's 1/2 is of the 30 cm ribbon only, Rahul's 1/3 of the 60 cm one; work out both parts in cm and compare.

simpler.hi: Dono hisson ki lambai alag-alag nikalo: pehle pehli ribbon ka 1/3, phir doosri ribbon ka 1/2. Phir dono lambaiyon ka fark dekho.
simpler.en: Work out each part's length separately: first 1/3 of the first ribbon, then 1/2 of the second. Then find the difference of the two lengths.

ladder.why: make 1/3 on a paper strip → the parts must be EQUAL before one is shaded
half of a big vs half of a small pizza → same fraction, different whole, different amount

viewCaption.hi: Yahan dono pattiyan do poore ki tarah bani hain: pehle ke teen barabar hisse, aur doosre ka ek bada hissa aur do chhote.

say.hi: Dono pattiyon ke teen hisse, par barabar sirf pehli ke. Koi hissa 1/3 tab hai, jab uske jaise teen hisse milkar poori patti banayein.
say.en: Both strips have three parts, but only the first one's are equal. A part is 1/3 when three parts like it together make the whole strip.

simpler.hi: 1/3 matlab poore ke teen barabar hisson mein se ek. Chhote-bade hisse gin kar yeh naam nahi milta; har hisse ki lambai barabar wale hisse se milao.
simpler.en: 1/3 means one of the whole's three equal parts. Counting big and small parts does not give this name; compare each part's length with an equal part.

sayAlt.hi: Teen dost ek chocolate baantein: ek ko aadhi mile, aur do ko 1/4-1/4. Kisi ka bhi hissa 1/3 nahi, kyunki 1/3 toh teen barabar hisson mein se ek hota hai.
sayAlt.en: Three friends share a chocolate: one gets half, and two get 1/4 each. Nobody's share is 1/3, because 1/3 is one of three equal parts.

prompt.hi: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

whyShort.hi: teeno hisse barabar nahi, sirf ek 8 cm ka

whyAlt.hi: Teen hisse gin lene se har hissa 1/3 nahi banta; 1/3 sirf woh hissa hai jo 24 cm ko teen barabar hisson mein kaatne par bane hisse jitna lamba ho.
whyAlt.en: Counting three parts does not make each part 1/3; 1/3 is only a part as long as the part you get by cutting 24 cm into three equal parts.

simpler.hi: Pehle socho, 24 cm ke teen barabar hisse kitne lambe hote. Phir har hisse ko usse milao.
simpler.en: First think how long three equal parts of 24 cm would be. Then match each part against that.

viewCaption.hi: Board par upar lambi ribbon 30 cm aur uska aadha 15 cm hai, neeche chhoti ribbon 10 cm aur uska aadha 5 cm.
viewCaption.en: On the board, above, the long ribbon of 30 cm and its half of 15 cm; below, the short ribbon of 10 cm and its half of 5 cm.

say.hi: 30 cm ki ribbon ka aadha 15 cm hai, 10 cm wali ka 5 cm. Dono aadhe hain, par poore alag hain, isliye lambai alag hai.
say.en: Half of the 30 cm ribbon is 15 cm, of the 10 cm one 5 cm. Both are halves, but the wholes differ, so the lengths differ.

simpler.hi: Aadha kitna lamba hai, yeh poori ribbon par tikta hai. Lambi ribbon ka aadha lamba, chhoti ka chhota.
simpler.en: How long a half is depends on the whole ribbon. A long ribbon's half is long, a short one's short.

sayAlt.hi: Ek bada tarbooz aur ek chhota seb, dono ko beech se kaato. Dono ke aadhe hain, par tarbooz ka aadha seb ke aadhe se kahin bada; aadha kitna, yeh poore par tikta hai.
sayAlt.en: Cut a big watermelon and a small apple down the middle. Both give halves, but the watermelon's half is far bigger than the apple's; how much a half is depends on the whole.

prompt.en: Red ribbon 36 cm, blue 24 cm. 1/3 of the red and 1/2 of the blue: whose part is longer, or are both equal?

reask.hi: 36 cm ki laal ribbon ka 1/3, aur 24 cm ki neeli ribbon ka 1/2: kiska hissa lamba hai, ya dono barabar?
reask.en: 1/3 of the 36 cm red ribbon, and 1/2 of the 24 cm blue ribbon: whose part is longer, or are both equal?

why.hi: Laal lambi hai, par uska 1/3 liya hai aur neeli ka 1/2; pehle har hissa cm mein nikalo, phir dono ko milao.
why.en: The red one is longer, but we take 1/3 of it and 1/2 of the blue; first work out each part in cm, then compare the two.

viewCaption.hi: Board par dono poori ribbon apni lambai ki pattiyan hain: upar laal 36 cm ki, neeche neeli 24 cm ki.

whyShort.hi: dono hisse 12 cm ke nikalte hain
whyShort.en: both parts come out at 12 cm

whyAlt.hi: 1/2 bada naam lagta hai, par woh chhoti neeli ribbon ka aadha hai; hissa kitna lamba hai, yeh naam aur poora dono milkar tay karte hain.
whyAlt.en: 1/2 sounds like more, but it is half of the shorter blue ribbon; how long a part is depends on the name and the whole together.

viewCaption.hi: Yahan dono pattiyan do ek jaise poore ki tarah bani hain, ek 3 barabar hisson mein aur ek 6 mein.

point.hi: Yeh do pattiyan bilkul ek jaisi hain. Pehli 3 barabar hisson mein bati hai, doosri 6 mein. 6 bada number hai, phir bhi 1/6 wala hissa 1/3 wale se chhota hai, kyunki wahi patti zyada hisson mein bati.

pointAlt.hi: Socho ek pizza 3 dost baantein aur bilkul waisa pizza 6 dost. 6 doston mein har ek ka hissa chhota hoga, kyunki pizza wahi hai. Board par bhi 1/6 wala hissa 1/3 wale se chhota hai.

did.hi: 1/3 aur 1/6 hisson ko milaakar dekha
did.en: matched 1/3 and 1/6 parts against each other

why.hi: pehli patti ke 3 hisse aur doosri ke 6, toh har 1/3 mein 1/6 ke 2 hisse aate hain

whyShort.hi: har 1/3 jitni jagah mein do 1/6

simpler.hi: Ek hi patti jitne zyada barabar hisson mein bate, har hissa utna chhota. 6 hisse 3 se zyada hain, isliye 1/6 chhota hai.
simpler.en: The more equal parts the same strip is in, the smaller each part. 6 parts are more than 3, so 1/6 is smaller.
